_source.name: AER, Residential energy consumption benchmarks, 9 December 2020 (Frontier Economics). Table 30: NSW gas consumption benchmarks (MJ).
_source.caveat: AER figure is TOTAL household gas; our model is hot water only. This is a plausibility and scaling check, NOT a predicted-vs-actual accuracy test. 2020 data.

finding: Model is plausible at 1-2 occupants and increasingly over-predicts above that. Linear-in-occupants assumption (inherited from the NSW ESS 45 L/person/day figure) diverges from sub-linear real consumption.
